name: Expedition Feature
summary: Expedition Role Feature Outrider Once per short rest, take the Dash or Disengage action as a free action on your turn. Claim-Staker Allies within 30 ft add +1 to checks involving your Claim Sight target. Trail Gunner When you score a critical hit with a ranged attack, the target is Suppressed until your next turn.
